verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a terminal-based text editor or syntax/lint checking in Termius. The only related evidence is a community report of running mutt over SSH, which shows that remote full-screen programs work but says nothing about file editing or linting. The documented features cover SFTP file management, snippets, autocomplete and workspaces, none of which provide editing or lint checks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can edit files with a terminal-based editor and run syntax/lint checkers inside the app
